tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/index.html. Insert exactly one HTML element inside the sidebar <aside>, directly ABOVE the existing thread-list div. No other edits to this file. Use synchronous DOM insertion (innerHTML or insertAdjacentHTML) — no async, no external libraries, no event listeners.

Behavioral specification: Add the following element exactly as written:
<input type="text" id="thread-search" class="thread-search" data-testid="thread-search-input" placeholder="Search threads...">

Acceptance condition: src/static/index.html contains the exact input element with id="thread-search" and data-testid="thread-search-input" positioned inside the sidebar <aside> above the thread-list div.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/threads.js. Add a module-level variable `let threadSearchQuery = '';` at the top of the file (or near other module-level variables). Add an 'input' event listener on the element with id "thread-search" that lowercases and trims the field's value into `threadSearchQuery` and then calls `renderSidebar()`. Guard the wiring so a missing element does not throw (if the element is null, skip attaching). In `renderSidebar()`, where it loops over `TC.threads`, when `threadSearchQuery` is non-empty, skip any thread that does not match. A thread matches when its title lowercased contains the query, OR any of its messages' content lowercased contains the query. The existing iteration order (newest first) and all per-item construction stay exactly as they are. No other edits to this file. No async, no external libraries, no network calls.

Behavioral specification: 1) Module-level variable `threadSearchQuery` initialized to empty string. 2) Event listener on #thread-search input event: `threadSearchQuery = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim(); renderSidebar();` guarded by `if (document.getElementById('thread-search'))`. 3) In `renderSidebar()`, filter threads: if `threadSearchQuery` is non-empty, only render threads where `thread.title.toLowerCase().includes(threadSearchQuery)` OR any message in `thread.messages` has `message.content.toLowerCase().includes(threadSearchQuery)`. 4) All other behavior unchanged.

Acceptance condition: Typing in the search input filters the sidebar thread list to only threads matching the query (case-insensitive, matching title or any message content); empty input restores the full list.
